# WebSocket (`source_type: websocket`)

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-probe-refs.ts from packages/probe-config. Do not edit by hand. -->

Opens a WebSocket and reports handshake time, message round trip, or whether the socket opened, chosen by `interpretation`.

- Runs on: an Observer Agent (set the metric's `agent` to its name)
- Thresholds: required when the metric is created (all four fields)
- testProbe: supported

## Value and unit

- `interpretation: handshake_latency` (default): `ms`: handshake time in milliseconds
- `interpretation: round_trip_latency`: `ms`: message round-trip time in milliseconds
- `interpretation: connection_success`: no unit: 1 when the socket opened, 0 when it did not

## source_config fields

| Field | Required | Type | Default | Limits |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | yes | string |  | URL |
| `protocols` | no | array of string |  | items up to 128 characters |
| `headers` | no | object |  |  |
| `header_refs` | no | object |  | values are env var names on the agent host |
| `ping_mode` | no | enum | `"none"` | `none`, `message` |
| `send_message` | no | string |  | up to 8192 characters |
| `expect_message` | no | string |  | up to 8192 characters |
| `timeout_ms` | no | integer | `10000` | 100 to 30000 |
| `interpretation` | no | enum | `"handshake_latency"` | `handshake_latency`, `round_trip_latency`, `connection_success` |

## Rules

- `url` must start with `ws://` or `wss://`.
- `interpretation: round_trip_latency` needs `ping_mode: message` and a `send_message`. `expect_message`, when set, must appear in the reply.
- Secret handshake headers go in `header_refs`, as for http.

## Example

```yaml
source_type: websocket
source_config: {"url":"wss://realtime.example.com/socket","interpretation":"handshake_latency"}
```
